note: Generated from docs/data/ and scans of the tree; do not edit. Each fact: value, the text a marker shows, and its source.

modules_reported.source: parity/<id>/results/summary.json and verify.json of the six modules, modules that have a summary.json

modules_verified.source: parity/<id>/results/summary.json and verify.json of the six modules, status verified and the status rule met

modules_match.source: parity/<id>/results/summary.json and verify.json of the six modules, 150 or more cases compared, none differing and every call record matching on the emulator run

cases_compared.source: parity/<id>/results/summary.json and verify.json of the six modules, sum of cases.compared

modules_rerun.source: parity/<id>/results/summary.json and verify.json of the six modules, verify.json says matches, dated on or after measured_at
